name: com.playtradex.sdk
description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.8.0-alpha extends the Unity blockchain SDK with the features developed from 0.6.0 through 0.8.0.

0.6.0 - Request Pipeline & Adaptive RPC Scoring
• Independent concurrent requests and network scoped sequential queues
• Adaptive RPC scoring using latency, reliability, failure penalties, and controlled exploration

0.7.0 - Transaction Lifecycle
• Internal transaction registry and signer/network coordination
• Concurrent nonce reservation, consent lifecycle, signing/submission tracking, and receipt lifecycle integration

0.8.0 - Events & Monitoring
• Background receipt monitoring for SendEth and Write
• Confirmed/Reverted mined transaction events with receipts
• Public C++, C ABI, and Unity C# event bridges

samples.description:
PlayTradeX SDK 0.8.0-alpha Unity sample covering the additions from 0.6.0 through 0.8.0.

0.6.0 - Request Pipeline & Adaptive RPC Scoring
• Demonstrates normal Unity operations on top of concurrent/network scoped request scheduling and adaptive RPC routing

0.7.0 - Transaction Lifecycle
• Demonstrates transaction consent, submission, and concurrent transaction lifecycle behavior

0.8.0 - Events & Monitoring
• Demonstrates separate submission responses and later TransactionMined events
• Displays Confirmed/Reverted status, transaction hash, network/chain information, and mined receipt
